_comment: KHANDAQ (audit 2026-08-21, K-04) — the desktop's bundled third-party inventory.
The desktop ships Qt 5.12.12 and OpenSSL 1.1.1w. OpenSSL 1.1.1 has been past End Of Life since
2023-09-11 and receives no public security fixes; Qt 5.12's extended LTS ended 2021-12-05. That is
lifecycle risk rather than a proven remote exploit, and it cannot be fixed by a version bump: Qt
5.12 cannot link OpenSSL 3, so the exit is the migration scoped in
What DID exist before this file: a prose comment at the top of windows-build.yaml, which had
already drifted (it said libvpx 1.14.0 while download_vpx.sh pins 1.14.1), and a version-free
table in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md. Neither was checkable.
`pin_file` + `pin_var` are the load-bearing fields: scripts/check-bundled-deps-eol.py reads the
real value out of the real build script and fails when this file disagrees, so the inventory
cannot drift the way the prose comment did. `waiver` is the vulnerability-backport policy the
audit asked for, in a form that EXPIRES and re-fails instead of rotting.
Regenerate versions after a bump:  python3 scripts/check-bundled-deps-eol.py --fix-versions

components.name: ffmpeg
components.note: 4.4 is an upstream LONG-TERM branch that still receives point releases (4.4.8), so it is not EOL — but it is the oldest maintained line and worth revisiting with the Qt 6 work.

components.name: libexpat
components.purpose: XML target descriptions for the bundled gdb; debug packaging only
components.min_version_source: CVE-2024-8176 (improper restriction of XML entity expansion depth) is fixed in libexpat 2.7.0. 2.4.1 (May 2021) also predates the Feb-Mar 2022 CVE wave fixed across 2.4.5-2.4.7. Upstream is at 2.8.3 as of 2026-08-21.
components.note: Bumped 2.10.0 on 2026-11-13: it fixes the seven advisories NVD attached to 2.8.3 since August (CVE-2026-66046, -76956, -76957, -113351, -115506, -117610, -118370; NVD lists none for 2.10.0), so they are retired rather than waived. The pinned digest is the one GitHub publishes for the expat-2.10.0.tar.xz release asset (543404 bytes); the Windows CI image build downloads the tarball, checks it against that digest and builds gdb against it, which is the first full build of this pin. expat is its own Docker layer built immediately before gdb and consumed by nothing else, so the messenger never parses untrusted XML with it, and gdb.exe goes only into Debug packages, not the published Release zip. History: 2.8.3 on 2026-08-21 (re-audit R-03) cleared the 2.7.0 floor unwaived.

components.name: openssl
components.purpose: TLS for Qt Network, and -lcrypto for SQLCipher
components.eol_source: OpenSSL Project — the 1.1.1 branch reached End Of Life on 11 Sep 2023; 1.1.1w is its final release.

waiver.reason: Qt 5.12 cannot link against OpenSSL 3. The only exit is the Qt 6 migration scoped in DESIGN-qt6-openssl3-migration-scope.md; bumping OpenSSL alone would break the Qt build and the runtime-DLL allowlist in khandaq-desktop/windows/cross-compile/build.sh, which hard-codes the 1_1 SONAME. Renewed 2026-11-10 (first opened 2026-08-21): the migration is still at the scoping stage, so the case is unchanged.

components.name: qt
components.purpose: application framework; Qt Network is the TLS consumer
components.eol_source: Qt 5.12 LTS: standard support ended 2020-12-05, extended commercial LTS ended 2021-12-05.

waiver.reason: Migrating to Qt 6 is a scoped project, not a version bump — see DESIGN-qt6-openssl3-migration-scope.md. It is also the blocker on retiring OpenSSL 1.1.1. Renewed 2026-11-10 (first opened 2026-08-21): the migration is still at the scoping stage, so the case is unchanged.

components.name: sodium
components.note: 1.0.18 (2019) is old for a crypto primitive; 1.0.20 is current upstream. Not EOL, no waiver, but it should move with the next desktop toolchain refresh.

components.name: sqlcipher
components.note: 4.5.0 (2021) encrypts the local profile database; upstream is on 4.6.x.

_comment: KHANDAQ (internal audit 2026-08-22, #20). Откуда на самом деле берутся версии по платформам.
Раньше компоненты объявляли platforms:[windows,macos], а pin_file у всех указывал на скрипты
кросс-сборки под Windows. То есть про macOS инвентарь утверждал то, чего не закреплял, и SBOM

windows.how: buildscripts/download/download_*.sh — версия и sha256 в самом скрипте; это и есть pin_file компонентов

macos.how: Since v0.2.48 scripts/build-macos-deps.sh builds every third-party library except Qt from source archives pinned there by version and sha256, for the bundle's LSMinimumSystemVersion; scripts/build-macos.sh checks the bundle against that macOS. Qt 5 is Homebrew's qt@5, unpinned. None of these versions are in this file, so the SBOM and scripts/check-native-advisories.py do not see them.
macos.gap: Carry the build-macos-deps.sh pins into this inventory (or generate them from it) so the SBOM and the advisory scan cover them, and pin Qt. Until then the platforms field says WHERE a component is used, not what is pinned.

linux.how: Ubuntu 24.04 packages of the build image (buildscripts/docker/Dockerfile.khandaq_ubuntu2404), unpinned, except what the image builds itself: toxcore from the copy committed under buildscripts/toxcore (since v0.2.48), toxext and toxext_messages from the archives download_toxext*.sh pin, and, since v0.2.49, FFmpeg 8.1.1 from the archive buildscripts/build_ffmpeg_linux.sh pins by version and sha256 (the release and digest of the macOS build). None of these versions are in this file, so the SBOM and scripts/check-native-advisories.py do not see them.
linux.gap: Та же работа, что и для macOS: состав снимать с готового тарбола (dpkg-query/ldd).
